task_type: production runtime reliability repair and controlled release
requested_outcome: Remove the intermittent public route failure, prevent stale release assets from recreating it, and publish one verified cumulative release.
natural_destination: https://vii.spaplus.co on desktop and 390 pixel mobile
authorization_boundary: Local diagnosis, repair, tests and one public Version and Deployment are authorized. DNS, schema, data, environment variables, sharing and permissions are excluded.

lesson_bundle.reason: The defect is intermittent and shared by public routes.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require cold load, warm reload, retry and affected-family evidence at the public destination.

lesson_bundle.reason: The user explicitly authorized production publication.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Record exact Version, Deployment, source, tree, environment revision and rollback.

lesson_bundle.reason: Only one controlled mutation is allowed.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Freeze a clean cumulative source and create exactly one Version and Deployment.

lesson_bundle.reason: The symptom can be caused by mixed release artifacts.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Prevent cached rendered HTML from surviving across releases and verify asset consistency.

lesson_bundle.reason: Mobile is a required VII surface.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Repeat route and reload checks at 390 by 844 pixels.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The generic error page is cosmetically changed while the original failure remains possible.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Repair the stale document boundary and retain data-source fallback rather than changing only copy.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The exact business route renders content after cold load and reload without either shared error boundary.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The fix works on one page but another shared route still fails.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Test home, vacation search and business detail as one affected family.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: All three routes pass on desktop and mobile.

predicted_rejections.rejection: An older source overwrites accepted work.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Release only a clean descendant that passes the protected source gate.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: qa:release-source reports clean and all protected ancestors and capabilities present.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A local success is reported as production completion.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Open and audit the exact public deployment after publication.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Repeated public checks pass and exact deployment identity is recorded.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A transient failure still leaves the visitor trapped.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use one bounded asset recovery and an offline shell that never replays old HTML.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Regression tests prove one recovery window and no navigation document caching.

affected_family: public homepage cold and warm load

sources.label: VII accepted reliability and release behavior

midpoint_gate.trigger: After reproducing a real public 500 and before publication.
checks: The built cumulative candidate renders home, search and business on desktop and mobile.
Reloading business detail does not expose a shared error boundary.

attack_questions: Can the public business route still return or display a 500?
Can an old service worker replay release HTML after a deployment?
Do home, search or business fail only on mobile or reload?
Does the release omit protected cumulative work?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Repeated browser and HTTP checks against https://vii.spaplus.co on the exact deployment.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Route reliability audit covering all three route families, desktop, mobile and reload.

effectiveness.baseline: Current public business detail reproduced an intermittent 500, while six immediate repeats varied between 2.7 and 7.6 seconds.
effectiveness.target: Zero error-boundary or HTTP 500 failures across the defined local and public route reliability matrix.
